headline: Food Importer Gellert Global Group Sues to Overturn Trump Canada Tariffs
summary: New Jersey-based food importer Gellert Global Group has filed a lawsuit in a courtroom test to overturn the 50% duties imposed on Canada.
why: Legal challenges against import tariffs can create significant precedents for international trade costs, corporate supply chain budgeting, and consumer goods pricing.
